entry.title: Creeper World 4 v0.2.2
entry.content:
Matched pair: install the plugin zip AND regenerate with this `cw4.apworld`. The plugin and the apworld share a version number and must match.
Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
**Existing yamls keep working.** The four hidden options removed here did nothing; a yaml that still names one generates normally, with a warning. **Seeds do not change**: the same seed number generates the same layout as in v0.2.1, checked for default, SPAN and casual logic. Nothing a player sees in the game changes.
- **The mod no longer carries debug code.** When the debug channel became its own plugin (2026-09-03), its commands moved but the counters, readbacks and tuning code they drove stayed inside the mod, and later debug features followed the same pattern. All of it is in the debug plugin now, which ships in no release. That removes a Harmony patch, a per-frame check and extra reads on every planet repaint that ran in every player's game for nobody's benefit. Nothing a player sees changes. - **Retired items do nothing.** `Build Limit +1 (Tower)`, `(Cannon)` and `(Mortar)`, `Emitter Overdrive Trap` and `Greenar Refinery` have not been generated for several releases; their names stay so item ids do not move. The mod no longer applies them, so one handed out by `start_inventory`, plando or `/send` is ignored. Factory still unlocks the greenar refinery. - **Removed four hidden options that did nothing:** `trap_weight_emitter_overdrive`, `filler_energy_storage_weight`, `filler_base_generation_weight` and `filler_build_limit_weight`. A yaml that still names one generates normally, with a warning. - **Slot data no longer sends** `mission_titles`, `span_missions`, `mission_requirements` or `ern_per_item`, none of which the mod read. The mod ignores them in an older seed. Placements are unchanged: checked old against new on the same seed for default, SPAN and casual logic. - **The apworld no longer carries test-only code.** The tests and audit tools record what the world placed from outside it, and the hooks the world kept for them are gone. SPAN map notes moved from the shipped `span_data.py` to the tools-side `tools/span_notes.py`. - **The game page** lists all three recommended options and describes the `easy` logic tier. - **Release checks are exact.** `tools/check_release.py` holds the mod zip and the `.apworld` to exact file lists instead of a blocklist, and reads the shipped DLLs' metadata for the debug-only names removed here. - **Corrected comments that were wrong**, among them a tracker colour that never existed: a mission with some checks reachable and some not is drawn green.

entry.title: A Little to the Left v1.0.1
entry.content:
**1.0.0 seeds: finish them on 1.0.0, or regenerate.** No location id moved, but the mod refuses a seed made by a different apworld version, as it has since 0.3.3.
## Install
**With a mod manager (recommended):** in r2modman or Thunderstore Mod Manager, choose A Little to the Left, search the Online tab for **A Little to the Left Archipelago**, press Download, then Start modded. BepInEx comes with it. The package is the same build as these files, on [its Thunderstore page](https://thunderstore.io/c/a-little-to-the-left/p/drohack/A_Little_to_the_Left_Archipelago/).
**By hand:** three files, and they carry the same version on purpose. See [docs/installation.md](https://github.com/drohack/alttl-archipelago/blob/v1.0.1/docs/installation.md).
- `ALTTLArchipelago-1.0.1.zip` - the mod. Extract into the game folder. **You need [BepInEx 6 for Unity IL2CPP](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be/755/BepInEx-Unity.IL2CPP-win-x64-6.0.0-be.755%2B3fab71a.zip) (be.755) installed first** - it is not included. - `alttl.apworld` - only whoever generates the seed needs it. Goes in Archipelago's `custom_worlds/`. Requires Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer. - `A Little to the Left.yaml` - your settings. Edit the name and hand it to whoever generates.
Every player needs the yaml and whoever generates needs the apworld, from this release whichever way you install the mod.
## What a player will notice
Nothing in play changes. This release is a smaller download and a stricter release check.
- **Less in the download.** Code the mod never runs is gone, and what only tests and developer tools use moved out of the shipped files: Core.dll 83 KB -> 60 KB, ModKit.dll 28 KB -> 22 KB. The apworld no longer packs hand-test evidence the generator never reads. - **Two settings left the mod's config:** `[Input] TypingSuppression` and `[Diagnostics] BadgeWhyProbe`. BepInEx leaves an old entry in place; it does nothing.
## How it was checked
- Full gate 30/30 and DLC gate 30/30 on these exact files, each from a fresh install that meets and answers the game's first-run prompts (Colour Assist, the multiple-solutions tutorial), with no game errors in either. - Not re-run, as nothing they cover changed: the by-hand solve of the levels the gate cannot force, and the level table against the game (`levels.json` and `abilities.json` untouched; `names.json` only in its `_comment`).
Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/drohack/alttl-archipelago/blob/v1.0.1/CHANGELOG.md).

entry.title: Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library v3.0.2
entry.content:
## Librarian-AP v3.0.2
Traps, a higher spare book percent for custom goals, and four fixes.
**Existing runs keep working.** Install over 3.0.1 and reconnect. The end door fix works on a run in progress; the other three fixes and the new options need a seed generated with the new apworld. A 3.0.1 YAML still works, but see the trap note below.
## New: traps
Traps are items that make things harder for a short while. They take the place of filler, never of anything a check or your goal depends on, and nothing a trap does is saved into your game.
**Traps are on by default.** A YAML that says nothing about them gets about 10% of its filler turned into traps, and that includes a 3.0.1 YAML regenerated with the new apworld. Set `trap_percentage: 0` for a seed with none.
```yaml trap_percentage: 10 # 0-100, default 10 trap_weights: # how often each one comes up; 0 turns it off Fatigue: 2 Floor Shuffle: 2 Veil: 2 Butterfingers: 2 Scramble Shelf: 1 Shelf Spill: 1 ```
| Trap | What it does | |---|---| | Fatigue | One magic skill recovers slowly for two minutes. | | Floor Shuffle | The loose books lying on the floor swap places with each other. | | Veil | The loose books you could pick up are hidden for 30 seconds, then come back. | | Butterfingers | Some of the books in your hands, from one up to all of them, fall beside you in a pile. | | Scramble Shelf | A few books in a row you have not finished trade places. | | Shelf Spill | A few books in a row you have not finished fall out onto the floor in front of their bookcase. |
The shelf traps never touch a finished row, so a completed row and its check stay done. Their notice says which bookcase and row they hit, for example "Scramble Shelf: 2 books on bookcase 2J, row 1 are out of order", and says so when one is skipped because you are carrying books or the shelves are empty. A notice shows on screen when a trap takes effect. In the multiworld the items end in "Trap", for example `Veil Trap` and `Sort Fatigue Trap`.
**Fatigue changed.** In 3.0.1 every seed had a fixed set of up to ten Fatigue items. Fatigue is now one of the traps above, so how many you get follows `trap_percentage` and its weight.
## New: higher `spare_book_item_percent` on custom goals
```yaml spare_book_item_percent: 10 # 0-100, default 10 ```
The range goes up to 100. Past 20 it only works on `goal: custom`, and only when the host allows it (`allow_high_spare_book_percent` in `host.yaml`, off by default). Other goals are held at 20.
## Fix: you could leave through the end door before your goal
Once every book you had unlocked was shelved, the game let you leave through the library door and play the ending before your Archipelago goal was reached. The door now stays shut until the goal is reached.
## Fix: individual book unlocks with count checks never showed any books
With `unlock_mode: individual_book_unlocks` and `check_mode: count`, the books you received never appeared. Seeds generated with the new apworld reveal them as they arrive.
## Fix: booksanity milestones were in logic from the start
With `check_mode: booksanity`, the "Correctly shelve N books" checks (with series unlocks) and, on floor and custom goals, the Reached Level checks past what the seed's rows can reach were in logic from the start, so the tracker showed them early and items could be placed on them out of reach. New seeds gate them by the books and rows you can actually shelve.
## Fix: random book bundles all came from the two starting sections
With `unlock_mode: random_book_bundle` and `bookcase_unlocks: unlocked`, the first bundles all came from the two starting sections instead of from across the library. Seeds generated with the new apworld draw every bundle from the whole library.
## Updating
> Extract the zip and drop `Librarian/` into your Steam install (overwrite). Drop > `librarian.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. **Both are required.** > The title screen should read `LibAP v3.0.2`.
## If something breaks
Press F8, then send that session's log from `Mods\Librarian-AP\logs\`, your YAML's `Librarian:` section, and one line on what you were doing.

entry.title: Death's Door v0.4.2
entry.content:
# Death's Door Archipelago 0.4.2
Use apworld 0.4.2 together with mod 0.4.2. Seeds generated with apworld 0.4.0 or 0.4.1 also work with mod 0.4.2.
## Mod (ArchipelagoRandomizer 0.4.2)
### Skip Cutscenes - The late-game story scenes are now skipped, including on saves that are already under way: - the Grey Crow opening Death's Door - the Grey Crow and Death in the void - Death's talk after the Grey Crow fight - the crows' scene in the Hall of Doors - the Lord of Doors' speeches before the gauntlet and during the final fight - The camera pans that show what you just opened are now skipped too. These include the Castle Lockstone braziers, the Lost Cemetery ghosts, crow souls flying into an Ancient Door, and doors, levers and cleared fights. - The ending after the Lord of Doors and the credits still play. - The few cutscenes that can leave invisible walls behind are always skipped, whether or not Skip Cutscenes is on.
### Shop - With Shop Hints on, looking at a stat in the shop shows the item its next upgrade holds and hints it. - Progressive Strength, Dexterity, Haste and Magic now show the shop's stat icons, in white, in popups and in the Recent Items list.
### Door and stat tracker - While the game is paused, press Tab (keyboard) or Y (controller) to open a tracker panel. A small hint in the bottom-left of the pause menu shows this: - With entrance randomization, the doors of the area you're in and where each one leads once you've been through it. In coupled seeds the way back counts too. Page Up / Page Down or the triggers show other areas. - With Shop Upgrades on, the level you've received for each stat and how many of its upgrades you've bought. - The shop's description panel now shows your current level of each stat. The shop's bars only show what you bought.
### DeathLink - Fixed the game crashing when it received a DeathLink. - A DeathLink that arrives while you're rolling, invincible or just respawned is no longer lost. It kills you as soon as it can. - Fixed your own deaths sometimes not being sent after you received a DeathLink. - A DeathLink that arrives while you're already dead no longer kills you again after respawning. - The game now shows who caused a DeathLink when it kills you.
### Fixes - Fixed a possible crash when the connection to the server drops. - The Grove of Spirits Door check is now sent when you arrive in the Hall of Doors, even with Skip Cutscenes off. - Fixed short freezes when planting a Life Seed in a new pot. They happened even with planting checks off. - Fixed a freeze in entrance randomizer seeds when a door led to another door in the same area, such as one Hall of Doors door to another. - Fixed a bug in ItemChanger that logged an error every frame in some areas. This made log files grow to over 100 MB and could cause stutter.
## APWorld (deaths_door 0.4.2) - Every Life Seed now counts towards the logic. The tracker now shows the Green Tablet and the goal as reachable once you've planted enough seeds. - On the Universal Tracker map: - Planting pot pins follow each pot's own requirements. The Crypt pot needs Fire. - The Imp Loft pot pin has moved to the Ceramic Manor left wing. - The "Beat the Lord of Doors" and "Open the Green Ancient Tablet Door" pins only light up once you can actually do them. - Entrance randomizer never connects two Hall of Doors doors to each other. - Grunt's Old Mask is no longer shown as glitched in the tracker when you can actually get it. - Leaving Ceramic Manor through the gate to the Estate of the Urn Witch is now in logic. The gate opens from the inside, day or night. - Universal Tracker's `/get_logical_path <place>` now lists the doors to take from the Hall of Doors, in order, with where each one actually leads in your seed. It only uses doors you've been through and paths you can walk with your current items. - New option **Shop Hints** (on by default). It controls the shop preview and hints described above. - Corrected the descriptions of Extra Life Seeds and Planted Pots Required.
## README - The mod and apworld READMEs are now one README, attached to this release and included in the mod zip. It covers setup from start to finish, every in-game Mod Option and every yaml option, including the new shop and planting options.

entry.title: Super Crazy Rhythm Castle v0.29.0r2
entry.content:
# v0.29.2 � Cell Tower escape fixes
**October 22, 2026. Client 0.76.2 / APWorld 0.29.0 (unchanged).**
## Fixed
- Cell Tower Access now keeps the return gate from the Central Mainframe room toward the Cell Tower phone usable, including its interaction, before the native level-attempt requirement is met. - Leaving that room toward Lobby before Fish Tears delivery now returns the player safely to Music Lab, avoiding the upper-Lobby hand-blocker trap. After delivery, the normal route remains subject to existing area ownership checks. - These repairs do not complete quests, grant items, send checks or change generated progression rules.
## Updating
Close the game and install **RhythmCastleAP-v0.76.2.zip**, retaining its included licenses. Keep your configuration, current seed and associated save. APWorld remains **0.29.0**; the unchanged APWorld download is included for convenience. No regeneration or tracker update is required for this client patch.
## Validation and scope
Both reported escape routes passed targeted user gameplay testing. The release contains the accepted native-interaction repair with a version-label update. Native-reference tests cover exact condition validation, idempotence, wrong flags/classes and failed writes; existing routing regressions are also covered. Full release validation is recorded in [testing](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/TESTING.md).
Separate investigation confirmed early Violance did not prevent Old Tom's note in the tested post-nectar state, and the Cell Tower Star Eater did not require Cold Storage completion after leaving and returning. Complete prerequisites are not yet isolated, so generation logic remains unchanged.
Intermittent performance stalls, extended-session/multiplayer coverage and remaining native-rule uncertainties remain in [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md). This release does not claim to resolve those reports.
See the [AI disclosure](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md) and [gate acceptance record](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/testing/2026-10-22-hub-escape.md).
Release validation: all 45 client regression projects passed, the Release build completed with zero warnings/errors, repository validation passed, and all 10 packaging tests passed. The APWorld asset is reused byte-for-byte from v0.29.1.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.7.0rc4
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.7.0-rc.4
**Pre-release.** Fourth test build of v0.7.0. Stay on v0.6.2 if you want a stable game.
This RC only lists what changed since the **[v0.7.0-rc.3 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.3)**. For everything new in v0.7.0, see the **[v0.7.0-rc.1 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.1)**.
### Changed
- **The Biome Finder screen is a map.** Right-clicking the Biome Finder now shows a top-down map of the biomes around you, next to a searchable list of every biome in your dimension. Click a spot on the map or a name in the list to track it. - **An arrow points the way.** While you track a biome, a small arrowhead floats just ahead of your view and turns toward it, like a compass needle. It faces you while you glide, swim or crawl. Its textures live in `textures/misc/biome_finder_arrow/`, so resource packs can replace them. - **Clearing the target.** The biome you're tracking sits at the top of the screen with a ✕ to stop tracking it. Tracking also stops on its own once you walk into that biome.
### Upgrading from rc.3
- **Only the mod jar changed.** Keep the rc.3 apworld and your YAMLs.
